entries.en: to resist; to withstand; to ward off

entries.zh: 挡住（一击）；承受、抵住打击
entries.en: to withstand a blow; to ward off a stroke
entries.notes: M 栏字母残缺（t[疑:u/e]ng），按「当」tòng「承受、抵住」读。

entries.zh: 顶撞；反唇抗辩（对所说的话不服、回嘴）
entries.en: to contradict; to talk back; to resist what is said
entries.notes: H 栏「佇遂」与 M「ngŏu piēg」形义皆不协，疑为「忤…」之残读，语义只可依 L 栏 resistir contra decir 推定。

entries.zh: 违抗；抵抗（对抗命令或说法）
entries.en: to defy; to resist (an order or a statement)
entries.notes: L 栏词尾残（deci[疑:r/m]~）；M 中 còng 对应「抗」khòng，首音节 àc 无字可对。

entries.zh: 拒绝；顶回去（不接受对方所说）
entries.en: to refuse; to reject; to turn down
entries.notes: M 栏「ñ cù」与「拒」常读不合，疑为否定词「毋」加动词，语义依 H、L 两栏定。

entries.en: to resist stubbornly; to hold firm; to persevere in resisting
entries.notes: L 栏缩写 perseveran[疑:n̂/nt]mente 须展开为 perseverantemente，语义无碍。

entries.en: to struggle against being seized; to resist arrest
entries.notes: H 栏次字「悖」与 M「chûn」形音不合，语义依 L 栏「抗拒被捉」推定。

entries.en: to withstand an opponent; to stand one's ground

entries.notes: H 栏次字「系」义不协、M「hē」与「脂」音不合，义依 L 栏 Resina de pino 定。

entries.en: to breathe; to pant; to catch one's breath
entries.notes: H「朝氣」与 M thiāu guǐ 同音，疑为「調氣」之借写，义依 L 栏 resollar。

entries.zh: 呼气；气往下行（舒缓喘息）
entries.en: to exhale; to breathe out; to settle one's breath

entries.zh: 喘气；临终之人急促的呼吸
entries.en: to pant; to gasp (as one dying)
entries.notes: H 栏字残（[疑:牝/牡]），M choān guǐ 合「喘氣」，R 栏「cǔi chvan」对音失真、L 栏中段 elan=cido 残损。

entries.zh: 口；以口呼吸（与前式相同）
entries.en: mouth; to breathe through the mouth (in the same way)
entries.notes: M 栏仅存残音（[疑:coa/cha]），H 栏单字「口」与「同前式」之义不衔接，姑按字面解。

entries.en: breath; to breathe (in the same manner)
entries.notes: H 栏仅「氣」一字，M 首音节 cān 无字可对，L 为重复条目，释义不足。

entries.en: to respect; to revere; to honor

entries.zh: 推崇；推重（以礼奉之，使其显尊）
entries.en: to esteem; to exalt; to show respect
entries.notes: R 栏残（es ca[残]ya o modo…），M「chǔi: chǔn:」与「推」常读不合，仅可依 L 栏 respetar 与 R 残句「使显尊」之意推定。

entries.zh: 敬重；遵奉（原字形义不协，释义存疑）
entries.en: to respect; to hold in regard (uncertain)
entries.notes: L 栏字母残（respe[疑:cl/ct]ar），H「務」与 respetar 义不协，M bú 只证音读。
M 栏首字母残（g[疑:c/k]èng），两可均读 kèng「敬」，语义无碍。
